runs.name: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P.; NYSE BEP, TSX BEP.UN, SEC CIK 0001533232, Bermuda limited partnership, 20-F filer reporting in US dollars under IFRS; about 47,200 MW of hydroelectric, wind, utility-scale solar and distributed energy and storage capacity held directly and with institutional partners, managed by Brookfield under a Master Services Agreement; BEPC reorganized by the plan of arrangement of 2024-12-24; 51% with institutional partners of the Westinghouse joint venture with Cameco; simplification into BEP Inc. pending, meeting adjourned to 2026-10-29; the 20-F names fuels, not firms, Clearway Energy and XPLR Infrastructure chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: Price **$28.40** (BEP close 2026-10-16, aggregator, flagged; BEPC $28.67 beside, not used). Units: LP units 305,987,962 on the 20-F cover (`Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing); per-unit base **684,176,085** on a fully-exchanged basis from the Q2 2026 6-K of 2026-07-31 (0001533232-26-000026): LP units 300,111,626, Redeemable/Exchangeable units 194,487,939, BEPC and class A.2 exchangeable shares 185,599,260, GP interest 3,977,260, counted as one class as the filer states they have the same economic attributes; market cap $19,431M. Sovereign **5.43%**, US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (issuing authority); earnings currency judged US dollars by the analyst. Read from the FY2025 20-F (0001533232-26-000011; Items 3.D, 4, 5, 6, 7.B and Notes 7, 13, 29), the earlier 20-Fs over the window, the Q2 2026 6-K and the 6-K of 2026-10-13 (0001171843-26-006567, the simplification meeting notice); `tools/run.py` returned UNRESEARCHED on the IFRS 20-F and every figure came from the filed statements. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 4, 3.D and 5, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN** on hydro, the deciding part at 43% of five-year segment Adjusted EBITDA and 40% of FFO (no part reaching half). **Q2 IN, narrowly**: the dams cannot be copied and cost little to keep ($199M of hydro additions in 2025 against $650M of depreciation), but hydro is a price-taker, its FFO fell from $668M (2021) to $607M (2025) and its cash cost per MWh (about $37) is above the filer's own wind ($29) and solar ($31); wind, solar and storage open castles, valued at no growth; Clearway and XPLR compared, operating profit over total assets 2021 to 2025 BEP 0.9% to 2.3%, Clearway about 1% to 2%, XPLR zero or negative (XBRL transcriptions, flagged). **Q3 against heavily**: about $25.8B net invested over five years while operating profit fell. **Q4 no STOP, against heavily**: featured 2025 FFO of $1,334M includes $852M of disposition gains and adds back all depreciation; unitholders lost money under IFRS every year 2021 to 2025; LP book equity is all revaluation (contributed and retained -$3,281M beside an $8,206M revaluation surplus). **Q5 integrity IN** (candid disclosure). **Q6 against heavily**: Brookfield's base fee and incentive distributions about $374M in 2025 against $482M of FFO without gains, under an agreement the unitholders cannot end; units issued repeatedly. Owner cash, the unitholders' residual after partners' cash flows (a CONVENTION of the run), five-year average **-$2,062M a year** organic (central, BEP a serial acquirer) and -$3,768M with acquisitions deducted; the depreciation variant also negative (2021, 2022). **Q7 OUT, on the floor**: owner cash negative on every case the filings allow; value range, no-growth case alone, **-$60.29 a unit all-equity (central), -$55.51 equity-only**; fair price **-$43.98 all-equity (central), -$30.14 equity-only**, neither positive, and the organic pair is already the central case, so no alert; the regulated-utility paragraph judged not to apply (contract and market sales, no allowed return); the most favourable case tested and not adopted, FFO with gains and no capital spending 6.87% of market value. Q8 to Q12 not reached. Balance sheets 2017 to 2025: total assets tripled to $98.7B, much of it revaluation; borrowings $34.9B, 90% non-recourse; LP equity flat about $4.0B while units were sold; non-controlling interests six times LP equity; current due to related parties $7.1B, of which $4.4B to Brookfield unsecured and payable on demand; pre-tax coverage about 1.04 times (2025). Strongest evidence against: recurring FFO fell from $713M to $482M while attributable interest rose from $539M to $969M, and distributions of $1,140M exceed recurring cash. Commits 747b4ec4 (Step 0, Q1, Q2), 4670fd58 (Q3, Q4), 7c8c6e2c (Q5, Q6), 96b2ab16 (Q7, Q6 write-back), 4f664948 (box, after the stop, self-audit, gaps); questions committed in pairs, declared. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Contamination declared: at the start the analyst listed `Test Runs/` filtered for "bep|brookfield", a search the blind rule forbids, and saw the file names of the BAM, BN (runs, a holding review, research passes) and BIPC files, none opened, nothing used, the self-audit box left unticked; BKH commit subjects and memory index lines, none used. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` 0 problems; the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` no missing id, 47 adjacent quoted fragments, 12 flagged and all read: filing quotes or the analyst's headings standing before an id, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) owner cash for a consolidator whose statements are mostly partners' money and debt, which basis and how partners' debt-funded distributions are treated; (2) the business-of-parts threshold on segment figures reported only before depreciation or after interest; (3) the commodity paragraph's low-cost test for power, cash cost, all-in cost or cost against the price-setter, which decides Q2 here; (4) the serial-acquirer test is trivially met when owner cash before purchases is negative; (5) a capital-recycling developer whose product is the gain on sale; (6) the competitor slot when the 20-F names fuels, not firms. A second analyst could close earlier: OUT at Q2 on hydro's higher cash cost, or at Q5 reading targets met by chosen sales as doubt. Could not get: a sustaining-capital figure (the filer says depreciation overstates it and gives none); consolidated hydro earnings against its $10,028M historical cost; depreciation by owner after 2022; the managers' pay (paid by Brookfield); the simplification circular. Not armed.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor (Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P., NYSE BEP; renewable power, hydro deciding at 43% of five-year segment Adjusted EBITDA; Q1 IN; Q2 IN narrowly, hydro a price-taker with a higher cash cost than the filer's own wind and solar; Q3 and Q6 against heavily, about $25.8B invested over five years while operating profit fell, Brookfield's fees and incentive distributions about $374M against $482M of FFO without gains; Q4 no STOP, against heavily, featured FFO $1,334M including $852M of gains; Q5 integrity IN; owner cash -$2,062M a year organic, negative on every case; value range -$60.29 a unit all-equity, fair -$43.98 all-equity and -$30.14 equity-only, not positive; no citation slip; not held; not armed; blind-rule listing declared by the analyst; framework gaps for the operator: owner cash for a minority-share consolidator, the parts threshold on pre-depreciation segments, the low-cost test for power, the serial-acquirer test with negative owner cash, a capital-recycling developer, the competitor slot)
